content:
# Client Onboarding Workflow
#
# DRAFT — defaults below are proposals. Replace owners, SLAs, and
# notifications with the actual values for your team.

workflow:
  name: client-onboarding
  version: 0.2.0
  description: >
    End-to-end onboarding for a new client, from kickoff through
    handoff to steady-state delivery.

  trigger:
    type: manual            # TODO: switch to a signed-contract or CRM event if automation is wanted
    initiated_by: account_manager
    required_inputs:
      - client_name
      - primary_contact_name
      - primary_contact_email

  definition_of_done:
    - All steps completed and approved by their owners
    - Client confirms access and readiness in the onboarding review
    - Handoff record accepted by the ongoing delivery team

  steps:
    - id: kickoff
      name: Kickoff call
      owner: account_manager
      sla_days: 2
      depends_on: []
      description: Introductions, goals, scope confirmation, timeline walkthrough.
      outputs: [kickoff_notes, confirmed_timeline]

    - id: intake
      name: Client intake & paperwork
      owner: account_manager
      sla_days: 5
      depends_on: [kickoff]
      description: Collect company details, billing info, and remaining signed documents.
      inputs_required_from_client: [company_profile, billing_contact, signed_forms]
      outputs: [completed_intake_record]
      approval: finance_lead        # TODO: confirm approver

    - id: provisioning
      name: Account & access provisioning
      owner: it_admin
      sla_days: 3
      depends_on: [intake]
      description: Create accounts, grant tool access, configure the client workspace.
      outputs: [access_credentials_delivered]

    - id: introductions
      name: Team introductions & comms setup
      owner: project_manager
      sla_days: 2
      depends_on: [provisioning]
      description: Introduce the delivery team, set up channels, cadence, and escalation path.
      outputs: [comms_plan, shared_channels_active]

    - id: discovery
      name: Discovery & requirements
      owner: project_manager
      sla_days: 7
      depends_on: [introductions]
      description: Gather requirements, priorities, and constraints from the client.
      outputs: [requirements_doc]
      approval: client_primary_contact

    - id: delivery_plan
      name: Delivery plan & first milestone
      owner: project_manager
      sla_days: 3
      depends_on: [discovery]
      description: Produce the delivery plan and agree the first milestone with the client.
      outputs: [delivery_plan, first_milestone_agreed]
      approval: client_primary_contact

    - id: handoff
      name: Onboarding review & handoff
      owner: account_manager
      sla_days: 2
      depends_on: [delivery_plan]
      description: Review the onboarding checklist with the client, close onboarding, hand off to the delivery team.
      outputs: [handoff_record]

  notifications:
    on_step_start: [step_owner]
    on_step_complete: [account_manager]
    on_sla_breach: [project_manager, account_manager]   # TODO: confirm escalation target
